decisive_spans.text: Transesophageal echocardiography confirmed vegetations on all three tricuspid leaflets

response.rationale: The presence of tricuspid valve vegetation on echocardiography and elevated inflammatory markers strongly supports Infective Endocarditis. While Marantic Endocarditis is also supported by the tricuspid valve vegetation, the overall clinical picture, including the elevated inflammatory markers, makes Infective Endocarditis a more direct fit. The other diagnoses are less supported by the specific findings.
